panel_descriptions.neg_0: A tall closed hourglass-like outline with curved inward sides, a slanted upper-left shoulder, and unequal polygonal ends.
panel_descriptions.neg_1: A small leaf-shaped loop above a short hanging cluster made from circles and a zigzag edge.
panel_descriptions.neg_2: A bent open strand whose upper section is a chain of circles and whose lower section is a zigzag.
panel_descriptions.neg_3: A short bent open strand with circles at the lower-left end and a zigzag continuing toward the upper right.
panel_descriptions.neg_4: A diagonal open strand progressing through squares, zigzags, circles, and another zigzag.
panel_descriptions.neg_5: A long open S-shaped chain composed entirely of hollow circles.
panel_descriptions.pos_0: A closed bow-tie-like outline with two opposing pointed lobes and inward-curving sides arranged around a central waist.
panel_descriptions.pos_1: A multi-armed figure centered on a compact hub, with opposing curved and angled arms decorated by circles, triangles, squares, solid strokes, and zigzags.
panel_descriptions.pos_2: A long narrow slanted parallelogram outline.
panel_descriptions.pos_3: A large hourglass-like construction with opposing solid outer bars and paired inward-running chains of squares, triangles, and zigzags.
panel_descriptions.pos_4: A compact angular S-like construction made from paired zigzag branches and opposing chains of circles, squares, and triangles.
panel_descriptions.pos_5: A closed angular bow-tie-like shape with two opposing broad curved lobes around a narrow center.
